saints.name: St. John Eudes
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A French missionary priest who spread devotion to the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary…
biography: Born in Normandy in 1601, John Eudes became a priest of the Oratory and won renown as a missionary preacher, serving heroically among the plague-stricken. In 1643 he left the Oratory to found the Congregation of Jesus and Mary, the Eudists, for the formation of clergy in seminaries.

He also established the Order of Our Lady of Charity for the rescue of fallen women, and above all he became a pioneer of the liturgical devotion to the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary, composing their offices and Masses. He died at Caen in 1680.
saints.knownFor: Promoting devotion to the Sacred Hearts and founding the Eudists.
